text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Thanks to NLP, machines can read and understand texts, which is called text understanding. This technology also makes translation easier and faster, so people can communicate across different languages. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where computers study what people write online and decide whether the feelings are positive, negative or neutral. Companies use this to learn what customers think about their products. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with people in a natural way. Today, NLP is everywhere, from search engines to virtual assistants on our phones.
